name: Steel yield strength (extra-trees ensemble)

cv.method: 5-fold cross-validation, out-of-fold predictions on all 312 steels

source: Matbench steels (matminer / Citrine Informatics), 312 measured compositions with yield strength; Dunn et al., npj Comput. Mater. 6, 138 (2020)
model_type: Extra-trees regression ensemble (80 trees), trained offline, run in the browser
